verdict.rationale: Poly documents importing existing notes into Poly Mind from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear, and more, and separately supports importing files from cloud drives and local machines. This covers the core switcher import path for Notion and Evernote. Nothing describes Roam specifically or what fidelity is kept on import. Missing for 10: Roam import, explicit plain-Markdown import, documented preservation of structure/hierarchy, links, and attachments, hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.
